instructions: PrimeKGAgent answers from a local copy of PrimeKG 2.1 (doi:10.7910/DVN/IXA7BM, CC0). Call primekg_data_status first; if ready is false, call primekg_download once (Biorouter asks the person: about 395 MB) and poll primekg_data_status until ready. Then use primekg_find_nodes to get node_index values, primekg_neighbours for a node's neighbours by relation, and primekg_paths for shortest paths of up to three edges. These queries make no network call. primekg_get reads dataset metadata from the Dataverse API only.
